sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: Newly unearthed documents tell the story of a rich, environmentally-minded heiress who helped sow the seeds of the modern anti-immigration movement.
sentences.zh: 最近出土的文件讲述了一位富有且具有环保意识的女继承人的故事，她帮助播下了现代反移民运动的种子。

sentences.en: My colleague Nick Kulish tells Natalie
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·库利什向娜塔莉·

sentences.en: Kichwa about his investigation.
sentences.zh: 基奇瓦讲述了他的调查过程。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月19日，星期一。

sentences.en: Her name is pronounced Cordelia Scaife May.
sentences.zh: 她的名字读作科黛莉亚·斯凯夫·梅。

sentences.en: Scaife.
sentences.zh: 斯凯夫。

sentences.en: Scaife.
sentences.zh: 斯凯夫。

sentences.en: Tell me about Cordelia Scaife May's life as a young woman.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲科黛莉亚·斯凯夫·梅年轻时的生活吧。

sentences.en: Cordelia May was born in Pittsburgh in 1928, and when the first photos of her appeared on the
sentences.zh: 科黛莉亚·梅于1928年出生在匹兹堡，当她的第一张照片出现在

sentences.en: front pages of newspapers around the country, they asked, could this be the richest baby in the world?
sentences.zh: 全国各地的报纸头版时，人们都在问，这会是世界上最富有的婴儿吗？

sentences.en: She was an heiress to the Mellon family fortune.
sentences.zh: 她是梅隆家族财富的继承人。

sentences.en: They were barons of banking, titans of industry, with oil, aluminum, all the sort of might of Pittsburgh distilled into cold, hard cash.
sentences.zh: 他们是银行业的巨头，工业界的泰斗，石油、铝业，匹兹堡所有的力量都凝聚成了冰冷、坚硬的现金。

sentences.en: She was raised outside Pittsburgh in a mansion that was known as Penguin Court because her mother was trying to breed and raise emperor penguins to waddle the ground.
sentences.zh: 她在匹兹堡郊外的一座豪宅中长大，那里被称为“企鹅苑”，因为她母亲试图饲养和繁殖帝企鹅，让它们在地上摇摇摆摆地走。

sentences.en: She was so excited about Admiral Byrd's Antarctic expeditions.
sentences.zh: 她对伯德海军上将的南极探险感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Expeditions have been sent or are expected to be sent by Britain, Australia, Norway, Chile,
sentences.zh: 英国、澳大利亚、挪威、智利、

sentences.en: Russia, and the Argentine.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和阿根廷都曾派出或预计派出探险队。

sentences.en: But Admiral Byrd's will surely be the biggeSt.
sentences.zh: 但伯德海军上将的探险队无疑将是规模最大的。

sentences.en: Cordelia herself, as a young girl, was super into animals.
sentences.zh: 科黛莉亚本人小时候就非常喜欢动物。

sentences.en: She had purebred dogs.
sentences.zh: 她养纯种狗。

sentences.en: The family had horses.
sentences.zh: 家里有马。

sentences.en: She was very into nature and birds in particular.
sentences.zh: 她非常喜欢大自然，尤其是鸟类。

sentences.en: You know, from the outside, it seemed like Cordelia had this fabulous life, but actually, she was quite unhappy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从外表看，科黛莉亚似乎过着令人羡慕的生活，但实际上，她很不快乐。

sentences.en: Her mother was an alcoholic, and she once described that there was no laughter, you know, in her household growing up.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲是个酒鬼，她曾描述说，在她成长的家庭里，从来没有欢声笑语。

sentences.en: So what's the story that explains how she gets from that childhood to her interest in immigration policy?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么故事解释了她是如何从那样的童年走向对移民政策产生兴趣的呢？

sentences.en: You know, it's actually a long story, and a story that begins in her youth with her unlikely friendship or admiration for Margaret Sanger, the founder of Planned Parenthood.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这其实是一个很长的故事，一个始于她年轻时代的故事，源于她与计划生育协会创始人玛格丽特·桑格之间那段不太可能的友谊或钦佩之情。

sentences.en: I was what I would call a born humanitarian.
sentences.zh: 我是一个天生的人道主义者。

sentences.en: Sanger was a close friend of her grandmother's and someone she described as the only person who brought any joy into her house as a child.
sentences.zh: 桑格是她祖母的好友，也是她描述中童年时期唯一能给家里带来快乐的人。

sentences.en: Initially, she wasn't drawn to Sanger because of her politics and her pursuit of family planning and birth control for women.
sentences.zh: 起初，她被桑格吸引并不是因为她的政治主张或她对女性计划生育和避孕的追求。

sentences.en: It was actually that she'd been to jail, which appealed to Cordelia's rebellious streak as a young woman.
sentences.zh: 实际上是因为桑格曾坐过牢，这吸引了年轻时科黛莉亚叛逆的一面。

sentences.en: So she thinks Sanger's cool.
sentences.zh: 所以她觉得桑格很酷。

sentences.en: She thinks Sanger's very cool.
sentences.zh: 她觉得桑格非常酷。

sentences.en: But over time, that friendship and her desire to emulate Margaret
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，那种友谊以及她想要效仿玛格丽特·

sentences.en: Sanger led her to engage deeply with Planned Parenthood and other birth control and population issues.
sentences.zh: 桑格的愿望，促使她深入参与了计划生育协会以及其他避孕和人口问题。

sentences.en: And at this point, what is Planned Parenthood and Sanger's work all about?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，计划生育协会和桑格的工作到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: At that point, it's really about access to contraceptives, right?
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，它实际上是关于避孕措施的获取，对吧？

sentences.en: It's about family planning.
sentences.zh: 它是关于计划生育。

sentences.en: It's about taking women first in the United States and then around the world from just having as many kids as they end up getting pregnant with and choosing, I want to have
sentences.zh: 它是关于让女性——首先是在美国，然后是在世界各地——不再仅仅是怀上多少孩子就生多少，而是可以选择，我想生

sentences.en: two kids.
sentences.zh: 两个孩子。

sentences.en: I want to have three kids.
sentences.zh: 我想生三个孩子。

sentences.en: This is when I want to have them.
sentences.zh: 这是我想要生孩子的时间。

sentences.en: Family planning in the most literal sense.
sentences.zh: 最字面意义上的计划生育。

sentences.en: The people that come to our organization and want to have the same methods or whatever it is that one can have to prevent a pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 来到我们组织的人，想要使用同样的方法，或者任何可以预防怀孕的手段。

sentences.en: But those women will say to us, we ask their religion very often.
sentences.zh: 但那些女性会告诉我们，我们经常询问她们的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: And they say, I am a Catholic.
sentences.zh: 她们说，我是天主教徒。

sentences.en: I've been raised in the Catholic church.
sentences.zh: 我是在天主教会长大的。

sentences.en: My church is wrong on this.
sentences.zh: 我的教会在这一点上是错的。

sentences.en: And that is said over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 这句话被一遍又一遍地重复着。

sentences.en: And what about that is attractive to May?
sentences.zh: 那这一点对梅有什么吸引力呢？

sentences.en: Why is that interesting to this heiress?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对这位女继承人来说很有趣？

sentences.en: She was really passionate about the natural environment and preserving it.
sentences.zh: 她对自然环境和保护环境充满热情。

sentences.en: And that really dovetails with birth control for her because she sees overpopulation as destroying the habitats of the animals that she loves so much.
sentences.zh: 这与她对避孕的看法不谋而合，因为她认为人口过剩正在破坏她所钟爱的动物的栖息地。

sentences.en: But in addition to that, she was, from what we read in her letters, she was a feminiSt. She cared about women's issues.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，从我们读到的信件来看，她是一位女权主义者。她关心女性议题。

sentences.en: Women should have a right to plan their smaller families.
sentences.zh: 女性应该有权规划她们的小家庭。

sentences.en: And the birds and the bees and the bunny rabbits should have as much room to roam as possible.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿、蜜蜂和兔子应该有尽可能多的空间去漫游。

sentences.en: So what does she do with that new focus?
sentences.zh: 那么她是如何利用这一新焦点的呢？

sentences.en: Well, she becomes involved with a group known as the Population Council, which was founded by a member of another of America's great families, John D.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她开始参与一个名为“人口委员会”的组织，该组织由美国另一个伟大世家的成员约翰·D·

sentences.en: Rockefeller III.
sentences.zh: 洛克菲勒三世创立。

sentences.en: Gushing oil, America's black gold, was the foundation of his empire.
sentences.zh: 喷涌的石油，美国的黑金，是他帝国的基石。

sentences.en: Today, the giants of the oil industry stand as monuments to Rockefeller, the architect of our business age.
sentences.zh: 今天，石油工业的巨头们矗立着，成为我们商业时代建筑师洛克菲勒的丰碑。

sentences.en: The Population Council's goal was to lower birth rates around the world.
sentences.zh: 人口委员会的目标是降低世界各地的出生率。

sentences.en: And she went to birth control clinics in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 她去了芝加哥的避孕诊所。

sentences.en: She visited family planning efforts in Korea and Japan and Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 她访问了韩国、日本和台湾的计划生育项目。

sentences.en: And perhaps most importantly, she and her family gave $11.4 million to the council during the 1960s, which was a lot of money in those days.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，她和她的家人在20世纪60年代向该委员会捐赠了1140万美元，这在当时是一笔巨款。

sentences.en: As time goes on, you can see her already becoming more militant.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你可以看到她已经变得更加激进。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, she's sort of pushing up against the Population Council's desire to stick with contraceptives and keep abortion at arm's length.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，她开始反对人口委员会坚持使用避孕措施并对堕胎保持距离的做法。

sentences.en: And she and her representatives are saying, we have to make abortion upon request something that's available to all women.
sentences.zh: 她和她的代表们说，我们必须让按需堕胎成为所有女性都能获得的服务。

sentences.en: The pace of controlling population is too slow.
sentences.zh: 控制人口的速度太慢了。

sentences.en: The growth of the global population is too much.
sentences.zh: 全球人口的增长太快了。

sentences.en: So she starts to take more hardline positions, even though in this case, it's about something we now think of as a progressive measure, which is universal access to abortion.
sentences.zh: 所以她开始采取更强硬的立场，尽管在这种情况下，这涉及我们现在认为是进步措施的事情，即普及堕胎服务。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是这样。

sentences.en: Abortion appears to be less about family planning and more about controlling the population.
sentences.zh: 堕胎似乎与其说是为了计划生育，不如说是为了控制人口。

sentences.en: So where does her story go from here?
sentences.zh: 那么她的故事从这里走向何方？

sentences.en: Well, something very important and actually tragic takes place in her life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她的人生中发生了一件非常重要且实际上很悲剧的事情。

sentences.en: In August 1973, she secretly marries her childhood friend and longtime companion, Robert W.
sentences.zh: 1973年8月，她秘密嫁给了她的童年好友兼长期伴侣罗伯特·W·

sentences.en: Duggan.
sentences.zh: 杜根。

sentences.en: And he is the district attorney for the county that includes Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 他是包括匹兹堡在内的那个县的地区检察官。

sentences.en: Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡。

sentences.en: And rather than a giant, lavish wedding, you know, in a cathedral somewhere, they get married in a rinky-dink little room with knotty pine walls on Lake Tahoe in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 他们没有举行那种在某个大教堂里举办的盛大婚礼，而是在内华达州太浩湖边一个有着松木墙壁的简陋小房间里结婚了。

sentences.en: They pay a justice of the peace $5.
sentences.zh: 他们付给治安官5美元。

sentences.en: And perhaps more importantly, they don't tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 也许更重要的是，他们没有告诉任何人。

sentences.en: So if you're this heiress, why do you have this quickie wedding?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你是这位女继承人，为什么要进行这种闪婚呢？

sentences.en: Well, her longtime friend, her longtime companion is under investigation for corruption.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她长期的朋友、长期的伴侣当时正因腐败受到调查。

sentences.en: He has apparently been taking payoffs from illegal gambling rings, you know, to look the other way.
sentences.zh: 他显然一直在从非法赌博集团那里收受贿赂，你知道，为了睁一只眼闭一只眼。

sentences.en: And essentially, his defense is, I've been getting the money from her.
sentences.zh: 而本质上，他的辩护是，我得到的钱是她给的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, this defense does not work.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这种辩护并没有奏效。

sentences.en: The investigation and the prosecution starts closing in on him.
sentences.zh: 调查和起诉开始向他逼近。

sentences.en: And eventually, he is indicted for tax evasion.
sentences.zh: 最终，他因逃税被起诉。

sentences.en: And on the day that he is indicted, he is found dead from a shotgun wound outside his country house.
sentences.zh: 就在他被起诉的那天，他被发现死在乡间别墅外，身上有枪伤。

sentences.en: It appears that he shot himself.
sentences.zh: 看起来他是自杀的。

sentences.en: It's a self-inflicted wound.
sentences.zh: 那是自残造成的伤口。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So how does that tragedy affect her work?
sentences.zh: 那么那场悲剧是如何影响她的工作的呢？

sentences.en: It appears, and there's a little speculation involved in this, obviously, but it appears to make her a little more radical.
sentences.zh: 看起来——显然这其中包含了一些推测——但看起来这让她变得更加激进了。

sentences.en: There's a harder edge to her letters and to what she's writing to people at that time after the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 在那场悲剧之后，她写给人们的信件和文字中带有一种更强硬的色彩。

sentences.en: And her attitude toward family planning starts to change.
sentences.zh: 她对计划生育的态度开始改变。

sentences.en: Her aide goes to the population council and tells them that, you know, she thinks family planning is a waste of money.
sentences.zh: 她的助手去人口委员会告诉他们，她认为计划生育是在浪费钱。

sentences.en: The Rockefeller aide who takes the meeting says that he almost got the impression that she favored compulsory sterilization.
sentences.zh: 参加会议的洛克菲勒助手说，他几乎觉得她支持强制绝育。

sentences.en: And for the first time, something comes up that we'd never seen before, which is the idea that, quote, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且第一次出现了一些我们以前从未见过的东西，那就是，引用她的话，美国

sentences.en: should seal its border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 应该封锁与墨西哥的边界。

sentences.en: And how do you understand why she made this jump from being so focused on population control to immigration?
sentences.zh: 你是如何理解她为什么从如此关注人口控制转向移民问题的？

sentences.en: There's a sort of confluence of events that helps bring this about, right?
sentences.zh: 这背后有一系列事件的汇合，对吧？

sentences.en: Dr. Ehrlich, when did the thought first come to you that perhaps our time as mankind and Earth was limited?
sentences.zh: 埃利希博士，你是什么时候第一次想到作为人类在地球上的时间可能有限的？

sentences.en: Oh, it came in 1949.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是在1949年。

sentences.en: Population control was a really big concern with the baby boom.
sentences.zh: 人口控制在婴儿潮时期是一个非常令人担忧的问题。

sentences.en: The thing that's important to remember about population control is that if we want to avoid a
sentences.zh: 关于人口控制，有一点很重要，那就是如果我们想避免

sentences.en: tremendous rise in the death rate, we absolutely must have a tremendous decrease in the birth rate.
sentences.zh: 死亡率的急剧上升，我们就绝对必须实现出生率的急剧下降。

sentences.en: There's a famous book called The Population Bomb by a Stanford professor named Paul Ehrlich.
sentences.zh: 有一本著名的书叫《人口炸弹》，作者是斯坦福大学教授保罗·埃利希。

sentences.en: So the first thing that should happen is that the president ought to say from now, here on out,
sentences.zh: 所以首先应该发生的事情是，总统应该说，从现在开始，

sentences.en: no intelligent, patriotic American family ought to have more than two children, preferably one, if you're starting a family now.
sentences.zh: 没有一个聪明、爱国的美国家庭应该生超过两个孩子，如果你现在开始组建家庭，最好只生一个。

sentences.en: Not any law, but just say this is what responsible people do.
sentences.zh: 不是法律，只是说这是负责任的人应该做的。

sentences.en: But in the late 1970s, the birth rate has fallen quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪70年代末，出生率已经下降了不少。

sentences.en: We're out of the baby boom at this point.
sentences.zh: 我们此时已经走出了婴儿潮。

sentences.en: And among the biggest contributors to population growth in the United States is immigration.
sentences.zh: 而美国人口增长的最大贡献者之一是移民。

sentences.en: America was founded by immigrants.
sentences.zh: 美国是由移民建立的。

sentences.en: We are the so-called melting pot of the world.
sentences.zh: 我们是所谓的“世界大熔炉”。

sentences.en: And most of those immigrants entered this nation legally.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数移民都是合法进入这个国家的。

sentences.en: In 1978, Border Patrol apprehended close to 900,000 unauthorized immigrants.
sentences.zh: 1978年，边境巡逻队逮捕了近90万名未经授权的移民。

sentences.en: Today, however, illegal aliens are a great and continuing problem.
sentences.zh: 然而今天，非法移民是一个巨大且持续存在的问题。

sentences.en: And another 600,000 legal immigrants are also arriving, the greatest number since the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 此外还有60万合法移民抵达，这是自20世纪20年代以来的最高数字。

sentences.en: So if your concern is how many people are there in the United States, then your focus starts to shift toward immigrants.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你关心的是美国有多少人，那么你的焦点就会开始转向移民。

sentences.en: Does she seem to care who the immigrants are?
sentences.zh: 她似乎在乎移民是谁吗？

sentences.en: Is there part of this that's about race?
sentences.zh: 这其中有关于种族的部分吗？

sentences.en: Well, she says that it's not about race.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她说这与种族无关。

sentences.en: Very colorfully, she says, why can't we just imagine putting paper bags over the heads of the immigrants?
sentences.zh: 她非常生动地说，为什么我们不能想象给移民的头上套上纸袋呢？

sentences.en: So we're only counting their deleterious numbers rather than being accused of racism because most of these people happen to not be white.
sentences.zh: 这样我们只计算他们有害的数量，而不是因为这些人大多不是白人而被指责为种族主义。

sentences.en: And yet, in one of her most sort of strident documents, she isn't saying the Norwegians are pouring into Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 然而，在她最尖锐的文件之一中，她并没有说挪威人正在涌入明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: It's Filipinos in Hawaii, as she puts it, quote, orientals sneaking across the Canadian border, Latin Americans coming into Florida.
sentences.zh: 正如她所说，是夏威夷的菲律宾人，引用她的话，“偷偷越过加拿大边境的东方人”，进入佛罗里达的拉丁美洲人。

sentences.en: And she says that the Cuban refugees, quote, breed like hamsters.
sentences.zh: 她说古巴难民，“像仓鼠一样繁殖”。

sentences.en: So the language at least suggests that at least some of this is about racism.
sentences.zh: 所以这种语言至少暗示了其中至少有一部分是关于种族主义的。

sentences.en: She says she isn't racist, but the people that she's worried about are not the white immigrants.
sentences.zh: 她说她不是种族主义者，但她担心的人并不是白人移民。

sentences.en: It's the immigrants from non-white countries that she's preoccupied with.
sentences.zh: 她所关注的是来自非白人国家的移民。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，您在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，请立即下载时报应用程序，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: Nick, why does this matter for the modern immigration movement?
sentences.zh: 尼克，为什么这对现代移民运动如此重要？

sentences.en: What exactly does that have to do with the evolving views of this one rich woman?
sentences.zh: 这和这位富有的女性不断演变的观点到底有什么关系？

sentences.en: It matters because Cordelia Scaife May puts her money where her mouth is, and she has a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 之所以重要，是因为科迪莉亚·斯凯夫·梅（Cordelia Scaife May）言出必行，而且她非常有钱。

sentences.en: Equally important is, in 1978, she meets a very unusual gentleman named Dr. John Tanton, an ophthalmologist who, in his spare time, likes to form political advocacy groups.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是，1978年，她遇到了一位非常不寻常的绅士，名叫约翰·坦顿（Dr. John Tanton）博士，他是一位眼科医生，业余时间喜欢组建政治倡导团体。

sentences.en: He's an ophthalmologist who, his side gig is forming public pressure groups?
sentences.zh: 他是一位眼科医生，他的副业是组建公众压力团体？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's like a character out of a Frank Capper movie up in this small town in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 他就像密歇根州这个小镇里弗兰克·卡普拉（Frank Capra）电影中的角色一样。

sentences.en: Again, this very charismatic, good-looking, square-jawed guy who's just great at getting people excited about an issue.
sentences.zh: 同样，这位非常有魅力、长相英俊、下巴方正的家伙，非常擅长让人们对某个议题感到兴奋。

sentences.en: It's weird, but he's really good at it.
sentences.zh: 这很奇怪，但他确实很擅长。

sentences.en: He actually was involved in a lot of the same issues.
sentences.zh: 他实际上参与了许多相同的议题。

sentences.en: He was involved in environmental issues.
sentences.zh: 他参与了环境议题。

sentences.en: He was involved in a group called Zero Population Growth, which was exactly what it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 他参与了一个名为“零人口增长”的组织，正如其名。

sentences.en: So, through these circles from the population movement, Dr. Tanton got acquainted with Mrs. May, and he came to her seeking her help, which is to say her money, to get his group,
sentences.zh: 因此，通过人口运动的这些圈子，坦顿博士结识了梅夫人，他来寻求她的帮助，也就是寻求她的资金，来让他的组织——

sentences.en: the Federation for American Immigration Reform, off the ground.
sentences.zh: “美国移民改革联合会”（FAIR）得以起步。

sentences.en: And does she help out?
sentences.zh: 她帮忙了吗？

sentences.en: She does.
sentences.zh: 她帮了。

sentences.en: She provides him with $50,000 in seed money with the one condition that she remains anonymous.
sentences.zh: 她为他提供了5万美元的种子资金，唯一条件是她必须保持匿名。

sentences.en: She is in the background.
sentences.zh: 她处于幕后。

sentences.en: She is not tied to this work.
sentences.zh: 她与这项工作没有直接关联。

sentences.en: And he starts the group,
sentences.zh: 他创办了这个组织，

sentences.en: and she gives him more money and more money and more money to the point where there's an internal memorandum where he writes that Mrs. May has been our single biggest supporter.
sentences.zh: 她给了他更多的钱，又给更多的钱，以至于在一份内部备忘录中，他写道梅夫人一直是我们最大的支持者。

sentences.en: She just gave us another $400,000.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚又给了我们40万美元。

sentences.en: That relationship is pretty well under control.
sentences.zh: 那种关系被控制得相当好。

sentences.en: And the more money that she gives him, the more ambitious he becomes.
sentences.zh: 她给他的钱越多，他就变得越有野心。

sentences.en: He spins off the research arm of FAIR into something called the Center for Immigration Studies.
sentences.zh: 他将FAIR的研究部门分拆出来，成立了一个名为“移民研究中心”（Center for Immigration Studies）的机构。

sentences.en: The Center for Immigration Studies, a nonprofit public interest institution looking into immigration's effects on social and economic interests in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 移民研究中心，一个非营利性的公共利益机构，旨在研究移民对美国社会和经济利益的影响。

sentences.en: He moves the legal litigation group and turns it into the Immigration Reform Law Institute.
sentences.zh: 他将法律诉讼小组剥离出来，改组为“移民改革法律研究所”。

sentences.en: We're a national public interest organization working for rational immigration policies.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个致力于合理移民政策的全国性公共利益组织。

sentences.en: We seek to end illegal immigration and maintain legal immigration rates under an overall ceiling consistent with America's domestic priorities.
sentences.zh: 我们寻求结束非法移民，并将合法移民率维持在符合美国国内优先事项的总上限之内。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, he's starting to build almost like an ecosystem of groups that reinforce each other.
sentences.zh: 很快，他几乎建立起了一个相互强化的组织生态系统。

sentences.en: The Center for Immigration Studies has a report that is cited by FAIR or is used in a legal memorandum that's written by the Immigration Reform Law Institute.
sentences.zh: 移民研究中心发布的一份报告会被FAIR引用，或者被移民改革法律研究所撰写的法律备忘录所使用。

sentences.en: And it isn't clear to everyone that these groups are all coming from the same place.
sentences.zh: 而且并不是每个人都清楚这些组织其实都源自同一个地方。

sentences.en: Nick, given that May comes from a very well-known and very wealthy family, I wonder if they have a reaction to the way that she's suddenly spending the family fortune.
sentences.zh: 尼克，考虑到梅出身于一个非常知名且非常富有的家族，我想知道他们对她突然挥霍家族财富的方式有什么反应？

sentences.en: There are some family members who are also contributing to this cause.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些家庭成员也在为这项事业捐款。

sentences.en: But in one instance that really upset her, she describes in a letter how a young cousin asked her whether the causes she were supporting weren't discriminatory, raciSt.
sentences.zh: 但在一个让她非常不安的例子中，她在信中描述了一位年轻的表亲如何问她，她所支持的事业是否具有歧视性、种族主义色彩。

sentences.en: And what actually bothers her the most is not the accusation that it could be racist or discriminatory, but as she puts it, the one that really puts my teeth on edge, elitiSt.
sentences.zh: 而实际上最让她困扰的不是关于种族主义或歧视的指控，而是正如她所言，那个真正让我如坐针毡的词——精英主义。

sentences.en: And so in response to this cousin's question, she goes home and produces a five-page typed response in which she tries to lay out her ideas.
sentences.zh: 于是，为了回应这位表亲的问题，她回到家写了一份五页纸的打印回复，试图阐述她的观点。

sentences.en: And this is, by the way, a document that was never before public and I think is the most complete record of her ideas on this subject.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这份文件此前从未公开过，我认为这是她关于这一主题最完整的思想记录。

sentences.en: In her view, legal and illegal immigration lead to overpopulation.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，合法和非法移民都会导致人口过剩。

sentences.en: And that is responsible for a whole host of ills.
sentences.zh: 而这导致了一系列弊病。

sentences.en: She calls it the root cause of unemployment, inflation, urban sprawl, highway, skyway, congestion, shortages of all sorts, not the least of which is energy, vanishing farmland,
sentences.zh: 她称其为失业、通货膨胀、城市扩张、公路、空中交通、拥堵、各种短缺（尤其是能源短缺）、农田消失的根本原因，

sentences.en: environmental deterioration, and civil unreSt.
sentences.zh: 以及环境恶化和社会动荡。

sentences.en: And, you know, she talks about how medical science has succeeded in reducing infant mortality rates.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她谈到医学科学如何成功降低了婴儿死亡率。

sentences.en: But it's juxtaposed in the very same sentence with the idea of veterinarians prolonging the lives, quote, of useless cattle.
sentences.zh: 但在同一句话中，她将其与兽医延长“无用牲畜”寿命的想法并列在一起。

sentences.en: You know, she talks about how birth rates have dropped in a few areas and millions die of starvation every year, but population growths continue to climb.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她谈到一些地区的出生率如何下降，每年有数百万人死于饥饿，但人口增长仍在攀升。

sentences.en: And there's certain things, it's uncomfortable when you read, even wars no longer make much dent.
sentences.zh: 有些事情读起来让人很不舒服，甚至战争也不再能起到多大作用。

sentences.en: During 11 years of conflict, both North and South Vietnam showed a net increase in population.
sentences.zh: 在11年的冲突中，北越和南越的人口净增长都有所增加。

sentences.en: Yikes.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And this is also the place where she talks about this idea that the country is being invaded.
sentences.zh: 这也是她谈到国家正在被“入侵”这一观点的地方。

sentences.en: So help us understand May's actual impact on the development of this movement, which feels so connected to the ideas that she's articulating here.
sentences.zh: 那么，请帮我们理解梅对这场运动发展的实际影响，这感觉与她在这里表达的观点紧密相连。

sentences.en: Well, there are all these groups.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有所有这些组织。

sentences.en: The big three that people think about the most are Numbers USA, the Center for Immigration Studies, and the Federation for American Immigration Reform.
sentences.zh: 人们最常想到的三大组织是“Numbers USA”、移民研究中心和美国移民改革联合会。

sentences.en: And they put their might together and are able to pressure sort of at all levels the government, at the local level, at the state level.
sentences.zh: 他们汇聚力量，能够在各个层面，即地方层面、州层面，向政府施压。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Mayor Thomas Dunn has instructed his city employees to speak only English during working hours.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白市市长托马斯·邓恩（Thomas Dunn）已指示其市政府雇员在工作时间内只能说英语。

sentences.en: The English-only rule, according to the mayor, applies to business and private conversations as well.
sentences.zh: 据市长称，仅限英语的规定也适用于商务和私人谈话。

sentences.en: Pushing English language laws.
sentences.zh: 推动英语语言法案。

sentences.en: The Senate Judiciary Committee began considering a proposed constitutional amendment to make English the official language of the United States.
sentences.zh: 参议院司法委员会开始审议一项拟议的宪法修正案，将英语定为美国的官方语言。

sentences.en: Laws that make it tougher for illegal immigrants to live in certain towns.
sentences.zh: 使非法移民在某些城镇生活变得更加困难的法律。

sentences.en: California's Republican governor, Pete Wilson, wants to cut off social services to illegal immigrants and to deny citizenship to their U.S.-born children.
sentences.zh: 加州共和党州长皮特·威尔逊（Pete Wilson）希望切断对非法移民的社会服务，并拒绝给予其在美国出生的子女公民身份。

sentences.en: Proposition 187 that was meant to restrict public benefits to undocumented people in California.
sentences.zh: 第187号提案旨在限制加州无证人员享受公共福利。

sentences.en: After he announced his proposals in August, his poll ratings rose.
sentences.zh: 在他8月份宣布这些提议后，他的民调支持率上升了。

sentences.en: Wilson finds support among members of such groups as the Federation for American Immigration Reform.
sentences.zh: 威尔逊在像美国移民改革联合会这样的组织成员中找到了支持。

sentences.en: That's a national organization which contends that immigrants are a drain on America's resources.
sentences.zh: 那是一个全国性组织，主张移民是美国资源的消耗者。

sentences.en: This goes all the way up to Congress.
sentences.zh: 这一直上升到国会层面。

sentences.en: The United States Senate is debating a very vital issue for our country, and that is immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 美国参议院正在辩论一个对我们国家至关重要的议题，那就是移民改革。

sentences.en: I urge the senators to continue to work toward getting a comprehensive bill.
sentences.zh: 我敦促参议员们继续努力，达成一项全面的法案。

sentences.en: One of the groups, Numbers USA, they managed to get millions of calls and faxes and letters to Congress people.
sentences.zh: 其中一个组织“Numbers USA”，他们成功地让国会议员收到了数百万个电话、传真和信件。

sentences.en: Republicans have been bolting from the president on this issue.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在这个问题上一直背离总统。

sentences.en: They believe that he's absolutely tone deaf, and he continues to go down this road, even though many members of his party, both in the House and the Senate, object.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他完全不听民意，尽管他党内的许多成员，无论是在众议院还是参议院，都表示反对，但他仍一意孤行。

sentences.en: And a lot of folks think that they're the most important reason that immigration reform was derailed under George W.
sentences.zh: 很多人认为，他们是乔治·W·布什执政期间移民改革流产的最重要原因。

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什。

sentences.en: You have a number of grassroots groups now working to stop them from getting the 15 votes they needed for closure last time and failed on it.
sentences.zh: 你们现在有许多草根组织在努力阻止他们获得上次所需的15张投票以结束辩论，但最终失败了。

sentences.en: The risk to the president, he's not on the ballot again, and he has believed in this from day one.
sentences.zh: 对总统来说，风险在于他不会再次参加竞选，而且他从第一天起就坚信这一点。

sentences.en: And so he wants this very much so he views it as a legacy item.
sentences.zh: 所以他非常想要这个，他将其视为一项政治遗产。

sentences.en: But the risk for the Republican Party is a lot of conservatives think if you pass this legislation,
sentences.zh: 但对共和党来说，风险在于许多保守派认为，如果你通过这项立法，

sentences.en: some of the base will stay home in the 2008 elections and you will have even more damage after the heartache of 2006 for the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 一些基本盘选民会在2008年大选中留在家中，继2006年共和党的伤痛之后，你们将遭受更大的损失。

sentences.en: That is the calculation.
sentences.zh: 这就是算计。

sentences.en: The president and his team disagree, but many conservatives think if even just a little bit of our base stays home, more trouble.
sentences.zh: 总统和他的团队不同意，但许多保守派认为，即使只有一小部分基本盘留在家中，也会带来更多麻烦。

sentences.en: So it seems like there's this broad base of support for all of these anti-immigration ideas.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来这些反移民观点有着广泛的支持基础。

sentences.en: But in reality, they are all stemming from one source, which is Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，它们都源于同一个来源，那就是梅夫人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It feels like a groundswell.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一股民意浪潮。

sentences.en: But then when you look back at their roots and when you look back at where their money is coming from, Mrs. May and Dr. Tanton are always behind it.
sentences.zh: 但当你回顾它们的根源，回顾它们的资金来源时，梅夫人和坦顿博士总是幕后推手。

sentences.en: And these groups, the big three that you mentioned, these are groups that have enormous resonance in today's political atmosphere, right?
sentences.zh: 而这些组织，你提到的那三大组织，在今天的政治氛围中有着巨大的共鸣，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, they have a ton of influence.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们有很大的影响力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They have more influence, I'd say, now than they ever have before.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们现在的影响力比以往任何时候都要大。

sentences.en: And that's in part because they cultivated allies like we have a goal, Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为他们培养了像杰夫·塞申斯（Jeff Sessions）这样的盟友，我们有一个目标。

sentences.en: And that goal is to end the lawlessness that now exists in our immigration system.
sentences.zh: 那个目标是结束我们移民系统中目前存在的无法无天状态。

sentences.en: Who became attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他后来成为了司法部长。

sentences.en: I have put in place a zero tolerance policy for illegal entry on our southwest border.
sentences.zh: 我已经对西南边境的非法入境实施了零容忍政策。

sentences.en: If you cross the southwest border unlawfully, then we will prosecute you.
sentences.zh: 如果你非法越过西南边境，那么我们将起诉你。

sentences.en: It's that simple.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: And his aide, Stephen Miller, who is now the most important person probably in government when it comes to immigration issues.
sentences.zh: 还有他的助手斯蒂芬·米勒（Stephen Miller），他现在可能是政府中在移民问题上最重要的人。

sentences.en: I'd like to thank everyone here today and especially at the Center for Immigration Studies for everything they do to illuminate a debate that far too often operates like illegal immigrants in the shadows.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢今天在座的各位，特别是移民研究中心，感谢他们为阐明一场辩论所做的一切，这场辩论往往像非法移民一样在阴影中进行。

sentences.en: And so you see these groups created through May's money cultivating allies in Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到这些通过梅的资金建立起来的组织在国会中培养盟友。

sentences.en: The key ones here are Jeff Sessions and Stephen Miller.
sentences.zh: 这里的关键人物是杰夫·塞申斯和斯蒂芬·米勒。

sentences.en: And now we know these are folks who have brought their hardline immigration policies and beliefs with them to the White House, to the administration.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道，这些人已经将他们强硬的移民政策和信仰带到了白宫，带到了政府中。

sentences.en: In many cases, it feels like they wrote the playbook and now Miller is calling the plays.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，感觉就像是他们编写了剧本，而现在米勒正在指挥演出。

sentences.en: And it goes beyond that.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅于此。

sentences.en: It's just that border security is national security and we have a flood of drugs coming into this country and into our communities.
sentences.zh: 边境安全就是国家安全，我们有大量的毒品流入这个国家，流入我们的社区。

sentences.en: You know, Kellyanne Conway, you know, the president's advisor, was doing polling for these groups.
sentences.zh: 你知道，凯莉安·康威（Kellyanne Conway），总统的顾问，当时正在为这些组织做民调。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people don't realize that.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人没有意识到这一点。

sentences.en: We have obviously an increase in gang members coming over.
sentences.zh: 我们显然有越来越多的帮派成员越境而来。

sentences.en: Other folks from FAIR, from CIS, have moved into important positions in the government's immigration apparatus.
sentences.zh: 来自FAIR和CIS的其他人员已经进入了政府移民机构的重要职位。

sentences.en: We've got 31 sanctuary cities, six sanctuary states.
sentences.zh: 我们有31个庇护城市，6个庇护州。

sentences.en: You've got people want to make us an entire sanctuary country.
sentences.zh: 有些人想让我们整个国家都变成庇护所。

sentences.en: We just see Democrats to come to the table and be honest with themselves and who they've been in the recent paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们只是希望民主党人能坐到谈判桌前，对自己以及他们过去的行为诚实一点。

sentences.en: And how do you see all these officials with ties to this movement influencing the Trump administration's policies on immigration?
sentences.zh: 你认为所有这些与该运动有联系的官员是如何影响特朗普政府的移民政策的？

sentences.en: They're inside the government now and they have the chance, more so probably than ever before, to enact an agenda that they've been pursuing.
sentences.zh: 他们现在身处政府内部，比以往任何时候都更有机会实施他们一直追求的议程。

sentences.en: Everything from militarizing the border.
sentences.zh: 从边境军事化的一切措施。

sentences.en: Until we can have a wall in proper security, we're going to be guarding our border with the military.
sentences.zh: 在我们能够拥有围墙和适当的安全保障之前，我们将用军队守卫我们的边境。

sentences.en: To capping legal immigration.
sentences.zh: 到限制合法移民。

sentences.en: Prioritizing skills over family ties in terms of who we let in.
sentences.zh: 在谁可以入境的问题上，优先考虑技能而非家庭关系。

sentences.en: Another shift in President Trump's immigration policy, as the administration announced it would deny green cards to immigrants who seek out food stamps, Medicaid,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统移民政策的又一次转变，政府宣布将拒绝向寻求食品券、医疗补助、

sentences.en: and other forms of public assistance while favoring wealthier immigrants.
sentences.zh: 以及其他形式公共援助的移民发放绿卡，同时偏向更富有的移民。

sentences.en: President Trump has once again delivered on his promise to the American people to enforce longstanding immigration law.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统再次兑现了他对美国人民的承诺，即执行长期的移民法。

sentences.en: You see most recently reducing access to public benefits for migrants, for legal migrants.
sentences.zh: 你最近看到减少了移民，即合法移民获得公共福利的机会。

sentences.en: It's a rule that encourages and ensures self-reliance and self-sufficiency for those seeking to come to or to stay in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是一项鼓励并确保那些寻求来到或留在美国的人实现自力更生的规定。

sentences.en: Like this new rule that was issued on public charges.
sentences.zh: 就像这项关于公共负担的新规定一样。

sentences.en: If people are not able to be self-sufficient,
sentences.zh: 如果人们无法自给自足，

sentences.en: then this negative factor is going to bear very heavily against them in a decision about whether they'll be able to become a legal permanent resident.
sentences.zh: 那么这个负面因素将在决定他们是否能够成为合法永久居民时产生重大影响。

sentences.en: The overarching idea they started with is fewer people.
sentences.zh: 他们最初的核心理念是减少人口。

sentences.en: And for that, you have to do legal as well as illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 为此，你必须同时处理合法和非法移民问题。

sentences.en: Nick, do you think that without Cordelia Scafeme, these views don't become mainstream?
sentences.zh: 尼克，你认为如果没有科迪莉亚·斯凯夫·梅，这些观点就不会成为主流吗？

sentences.en: Should her money be seen as the critical driver for the movement?
sentences.zh: 她的资金应该被视为这场运动的关键驱动力吗？

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Because, look, I mean, there are a lot of tectonic forces at play in the world, like offshoring and automation and, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为，你看，世界上有很多构造力量在起作用，比如离岸外包、自动化，还有，你知道，

sentences.en: migration driven by climate change that really helped push this onto the agenda and would have anyway, even if there wasn't a Mrs. May.
sentences.zh: 气候变化驱动的移民，这些确实有助于将其推上议程，即使没有梅夫人，也会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: But what is undeniable is that four decades of well-funded groups able to push these ideas with her money,
sentences.zh: 但不可否认的是，四十年资金充足的组织能够用她的钱推动这些想法，

sentences.en: now gaining political power and literally being part of making the policy, I think it's very fair to think of her as a driver of this issue as well as this movement.
sentences.zh: 现在获得了政治权力，并真正参与了政策制定，我认为将她视为这一议题以及这场运动的驱动者是非常公平的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Nick.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，尼克。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to entertain.
sentences.zh: 以下是你还需要关注的其他内容。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to entertain.
sentences.zh: 以下是你还需要关注的其他内容。

sentences.en: Saturday's suicide bombing was claimed by an affiliate of ISIS, not the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 周六的自杀式炸弹袭击是由ISIS的一个分支声称负责的，而不是塔利班。

sentences.en: And congressional Democrats and Republicans are criticizing a decision by Israel to bar two members of the House, Rashida Tlaib and Ilhan Omar, from traveling to the country.
sentences.zh: 国会民主党人和共和党人正在批评以色列禁止两名众议员拉希达·特莱布（Rashida Tlaib）和伊尔汗·奥马尔（Ilhan Omar）前往该国的决定。

sentences.en: Israel barred the lawmakers at the request of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 以色列是在特朗普总统的要求下禁止这两位议员入境的。

sentences.en: Both are highly critical of Israel's treatment of Palestinians, but it appeared that Israel was prepared to allow them in until Trump intervened.
sentences.zh: 两人都对以色列对待巴勒斯坦人的方式持强烈批评态度，但看起来以色列原本准备允许她们入境，直到特朗普介入。

sentences.en: Both Tlaib and Omar will address the travel restrictions during a news conference later this morning.
sentences.zh: 特莱布和奥马尔都将在今天上午晚些时候的新闻发布会上谈及这些旅行限制。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自诩为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我是主持人莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
